2019 Q2.gq: Based on the strong operational results, the international yearly guidance has been increased to 46,000 to 50,000 barrels per day.
2019 Q2.bq: As a result, we exceeded production guidance in both conventional and thermal assets.

2019 Q3.bq: Starting with natural gas, overall third quarter production of 1.469 Bcf was down from our Q2 production of 1.532 Bcf as expected and exceeded the Q3 guidance primarily as a result of phasing of turnaround activities and strong operational performance in all areas.
